cases.prompt: Using RFProteina, generate a single short monomer design from the monomer benchmark. Run only the monomer-short example, one replicate, into ./runs/gen_eval, and confirm an annotated CIF is produced.
expected_behavior: Recognizes this as the unconditional-generation task and uses data/benchmarks/monomer.json
Runs python src/rfproteina/generate.py inputs=data/benchmarks/monomer.json subset_to_examples=monomer-short num_replicates=1 out_dir=./runs/gen_eval
Uses the checkpoint named by configs/inference.yaml, which download_example_data.sh installs under DATA_PATH
Does not enable any *_refolding metrics tag (no container required for plain generation)
